batch: Transport Miniature World menu pilot v1
reference: Plants illustrated menu, modes learn, detective and wheel, used as composition reference only

assets.prompt: A finished, individual transparent menu illustration for a children’s Transport Town learning game. Miniature World: detailed hand-painted gouache and subtle grain on tactile painted wooden and paper objects, softly shaded volume, restrained dark navy outlines, ivory paper, warm brass/gold trim, petrol blue and teal accents, yellow and red vehicle accents. Picture-led like a beautifully illustrated children's field guide, rich but readable, neither generic vector icon nor glossy 3D. One clear activity object with supporting pieces composing a single clustered silhouette. Full subject centred, all edges in frame, artwork fills about 82–88% of the long canvas dimension. Preserve clear negative space around perimeter. Real transparent RGBA background. No type, lettering, title, menu card, enclosing rectangle, interface, watermark, hard outside shadow, or landscape behind the cutout. The live menu adds its own cream card and title. Use a slightly elevated three-quarter overhead view of one wide open illustrated transport field guide, with visible navy cloth binding and ochre trim, warm cream spread, and a short red bookmark ribbon. Left page: one large sunny yellow miniature bus illustration and a small diagram of a road. Right page: a readable cream-and-teal ferry on a little painted blue patch and a small bright red-and-ivory airplane study. Images painted onto the book pages, no text or scribble lines, no extra book. The open book is the dominant shape. A balanced wide silhouette with roughly 1.5:1 visible proportions; book reaches close to both sides. Rich layered miniature craft like an illustrated museum guide.
